verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine ships several official CLI surfaces: command-line arguments for the Editor/Engine (unreal-docs-7, unreal-docs-14, unreal-docs-32), the Unreal Automation Tool for scripting builds/tests (unreal-docs-30), and UnrealEditor.exe cook/package commands (unreal-docs-16, unreal-docs-36, unreal-docs-17), all of which an AI agent could invoke non-interactively. missing for 10: no explicit framing of the CLI as AI-agent-oriented, no independent/hands-on corroboration of agents actually driving these CLIs, and no unified single 'ue' CLI tool comparable to other AI-native product CLIs.
